China is described as appreciating it."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E006","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"On 21 March 2023, Xi and Putin signed a joint statement calling for responsible dialogue, avoidance of escalation and protracted fighting, and respect for international law and the UN Charter; it also recorded Russia’s commitment to resume Ukraine peace talks, which China appreciated.","notes":["The excerpt attributes the peace-talk commitment specifically to Russia, rather than presenting it as a joint call by both leaders."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E009","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"China’s 2023 health-insurance bulletin reported 1.33389 billion basic-medical-insurance enrollees, 802,000 inspected medical institutions, 451,000 institutions processed for violations, and 186.5 billion yuan in recovered funds; it also reported 74.6 billion yuan in medical assistance, support for 80.2 million people, and rural low-income enrollment above 99%.","notes":["The excerpt reports 80.2万家 inspected institutions, meaning 802,000, not 80.2 million."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E011","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"A Council on Foreign Relations report published in August 2023 stated that China was expanding its nuclear arsenal; it reported a Pentagon projection that China could reach as many as 1,500 strategic warheads by 2035 and described China as appearing to invest heavily in hypersonic missiles.","notes":["The excerpt attributes the 1,500-warhead projection to the Pentagon, not to unspecified experts’ estimates."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
